description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing LoanInstallmentDelinquencyTag entities, providing methods for querying, deleting, and interacting with delinquency tags associated with loan installments.

classes.name: LoanInstallmentDelinquencyTagRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for LoanInstallmentDelinquencyTag entities, extending JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor to provide CRUD operations and custom queries related to delinquency tags.

methods.name: findByLoanAndInstallment
methods.description: Retrieves a LoanInstallmentDelinquencyTag associated with a specific Loan and installment.

methods.name: findByLoanId
methods.description: Fetches all delinquency tags associated with a particular loan, identified by loanId.

methods.name: findInstallmentDelinquencyTags
methods.description: Returns specific delinquency details (installment id, delinquency range, outstanding amount) for a given loan.

methods.name: deleteAllLoanInstallmentsTags
methods.description: Deletes all delinquency tags associated with a specific loan.

methods.name: deleteAllLoanInstallmentsTagsByIds
methods.description: Deletes multiple delinquency tags identified by their IDs.
